sentences.text: A perusal of the record shows that in the entire record as well as in the mark-sheets of that complainant Pushpa is daughter of Lalta Prasad.
There is no documentary evidence on record which shows that Pushpa is daughter of Mansha Ram.
The name of Mansha Ram is alleged to have been added with the connivance of the present revisionist.
Learned court below while summoning the accused revisionist has gone in great detail and after finding prima facie commission of offence summons were issued.

sentences.text: In the aforesaid discussions, there appears to be no illegality in the impugned order.
Prima faice commission of cognizable offence is made out and therefore, the appeal being devoid of merits is dismissed.

At this stage, learned counsel for the appellant prays that he may be given liberty to file a regular bail application in view of law laid by Supreme Court in order dated 7.10.2021 passed in Petition for Special Leave to Appeal (Cri) No.5191 of 2021 Satender Kumar Antil versus Central Bureau of Investigation and another.
